name: valuation-workpaper
title: DRAFT valuation workpaper
for_each: select id,name from engagements order by code

sections.title: Draft method results
sections.note: Calculations from entered assumptions, not an issued valuation opinion. Book net assets are not fair-value net assets. No automatic weighting of methods. A qualified practitioner must assess inputs, suitability and report disclosures.
sections.sql: select scenario,currency,multiples_equity as multiples_equity_amount,dcf_equity as dcf_equity_amount,book_net_assets as book_net_assets_amount,calculation_state from v_valuations where engagement_id=$1

sections.title: Forecast cash flows to the firm
sections.sql: select year_no,cashflow,source from forecasts where engagement_id=$1 order by year_no

sections.title: Evidence trail
sections.sql: select name,source,observed_on,review_due,owner from evidence where engagement_id=$1

sections.title: Review exceptions
sections.sql: select rule,finding,source from v_compliance where engagement_id=$1

sections.title: Review history
sections.sql: select revision,reviewer,decision,note,created_at from reviews where engagement_id=$1 order by created_at

name: information-request
title: DRAFT information request
for_each: select id,name from engagements order by code

sections.title: Outstanding items
sections.note: For operator review before sending. No messages are sent by this software.
sections.sql: select name,owner,due_date from actions where engagement_id=$1 and status='open' order by due_date

sections.title: Evidence to check
sections.sql: select name,source,review_due from evidence where engagement_id=$1 order by review_due
